svg.aria-label: Danish Roti: Frontend Engineer, Tool Builder, Fiction Writer. Ship's log, day 1841: Somewhere aft, a panel rattled. I have stopped asking which one. The open channels stayed quiet. Below deck, the engines ran anyway. Logging off. The stars can keep watch.

g.text: Somewhere aft, a panel rattled. I
The hull ticked as it cooled.
through the glass and marked it
The radio gave us twenty minutes
